within_game.note: All pairs are priced from the two quoted sides of each market. Mutually exclusive combinations (home/away ATS, over/under, home/away ML) are excluded because they cannot both win.

across_game.note: Legs are drawn independently across games (HOME_ATS from one game, OVER from another, alternating). Independence means lift ~ 1.00 and the EV is set by the compounded vig: this is the 'parlay tax'.

combos.pricing_note: Naive product pricing only. Real SGP engines price the correlation, so this is a measure of correlation strength, not free money.

kelly.note: Positive Kelly requires positive edge. A zero or tiny fraction means the bet is not worth placing.

method: phi and joint frequencies are measured on settled games with two-sided quotes. Book parlay price = product of quoted decimals (the standard rule, no correlation adjustment for cross-game parlays; some books do adjust SGPs).
